name: Higuchi Hotaru
source:
Zodiac: Cancer
Precise weight: 41.5 kg.

A mysterious girl who goes to the same school as [url=/c115180]Shin'ya[/url].
Hotaru doesn't seem know where she lives nor who her parents are, even though she's been with him for a long, long time. Sometimes she appears in front of him unexpectedly and it appears they tried to date in the past.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031014071144/http://www.pinkpineapple.co.jp/pinpai/xmas/character/character.html]official website[/url].]
